cmudict.txt is the Carnegie Mellon University Pronouncing Dictionary (CMUdict), as packaged by the
npm module cmu-pronouncing-dictionary 3.0.0 (ISC licence, see LICENSE-package-ISC.txt), repacked by
Xenoglot into one line per word: the word, a space, then each sound as one character (AA AE AH AO AW AY
EH ER EY IH IY OW OY UH UW B CH D DH F G HH JH K L M N NG P R S SH T TH V W Y Z ZH = a b c ... z A B ... M),
vowels followed by their stress (0, 1 or 2). Comments and entries with characters other than letters
and an apostrophe were dropped.
